text:
Nina Park: Quick run: the rules editor preview still has a few small jank moments. Main issues: ghost slot placement, validation toast z-order, and keyboard announcements.
Omar Velasquez: Ghost slot often appears 1 row off when you drag across a sticky group header. I think our visible-index calc uses full-list indexes not visible indexes.
Benji: Yep. Using virtualized list means DOM index != logical position. We should compute target index from visible nodes only and map back to model id for the animation.
Rae (a11y): Also keyboard drag: no aria-live update when a rule moves between groups. Screen reader users get lost. Need a pattern: announce origin, then each move with context.
Nina Park: Proposed copy for announcement: "Moving rule 'Block Suspicious' — position 4 of 7, between 'Auth' and 'Rate Limit'". Keep it short.
Rae (a11y): That works. Use aria-live="polite" and update only after settle (100ms) to avoid chattiness.
Omar Velasquez: For ghost UI, suggestion: show the ghost slot with a small label bubble that includes the future priority number and group name, e.g., "#3 — inside 'Allowlist'". Also reduce ghost opacity to 0.92 so it reads as placeholder.
Benji: Implementation note: don't compute priority label on every mousemove. Capture the intended slot at dragstart and only update when crossing a stable boundary. Saves reflow.
Nina Park: Toasts: validation toasts pop behind the sim preview panel. They have global z=900, modal uses z=1000. Either portal to modal or put toasts into an overlay layer with z=1100. But watch focus.
Rae (a11y): If toasts are portaled to modal, ensure they are aria-live only and don't autofocus. If we use role="status" they won't steal focus. Also check contrast: the compact validation pill is failing 3:1, need >=4.5:1 for small text.
Omar Velasquez: Copy tweak: current error "Rule invalid" -> change to "Rule invalid: missing match condition. Press E to edit or click to open rule panel." Short and actionable.
Benji: Dev concern: deep-linking the failing field requires stable client-side rule ids. We'll add a stable frontend id field persisted in the draft model so deep links survive reorders.
Nina Park: Animation policy: when dragging between groups, animate the ghost slot snapping to the nearest visible boundary instead of following the cursor. This reduces perceived teleportation.
Rae (a11y): For keyboard mode: when user enters drag mode announce "Drag mode enabled. Use ↑/↓ to move, Enter to drop, Esc to cancel." On each move announce position and nearby siblings. Keep announcements concise.
Omar Velasquez: Sim preview perf: currently we re-run evaluation on every list update — extremely chatty. Add a 250ms debounce and cancel inflight sim calls on new changes.
Benji: Also show a subtle spinner in the sim pane when debounce is pending so users know results are outdated.
Nina Park: Small UI nit: token counters overlay the insertion line in narrow layouts. Move counters to the preview header while dragging or fade them to 40% opacity.
Rae (a11y): I'll run quick axe checks for focus order, contrast for ghost label and toast, and provide exact color suggestions. Will paste results to the design doc.
ui-bot: Reminder: design sync Monday 11am PT. Agenda: ghost-slot snap behavior, keyboard announcement copy, toast layering, validation copy. Please attach short gifs/screenshots before noon Monday. :spiral_calendar:
